title: Singular personal partitive pronouns
focus: Use minua, sinua and häntä for a singular personal object.

exercises.prompt: You = one person. Complete “You are waiting for me.” Odotat ____.
exercises.explanation: Use minua, sinua or häntä as the singular personal object in this taught verb pattern. The standard written partitive form of minä is minua; learn this pronoun form directly.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Singular personal partitive pronouns: form or use confused
